name: tokenos-wallet-inspector
description: Check any Solana wallet, token or transaction in seconds — balances, holdings, holder concentration and rug-pull risk signals.
keywords: what tokens does this wallet hold

interface.longDescription:
Look up any Solana wallet address to see its SOL balance, every SPL and Token-2022 holding with live USD values, and recent activity. Paste a token mint to get supply, price, market cap, mint/freeze authority status, top-holder concentration and a plain-English risk read. Paste a transaction signature to get it explained. Read-only: nothing to connect or sign.

Tools:
• inspect_wallet — Return SOL balance, all token holdings with USD values, total tracked value and the 10 most recent transactions for a Solana wallet address.
• check_token — Return supply, price, market cap, mint/freeze authority status, metadata mutability, top-20 holders with concentration, and a heuristic rug-risk score for a token mint.
• explain_transaction — Decode a transaction signature: status, fee, programs invoked, SOL and token balance changes, and the last log lines.

Targets questions like: “check solana wallet”; “solana wallet balance”; “what tokens does this wallet hold”; “is this token a rug”; “solana token holders”; “solana transaction explained”.

Documentation: https://tokenos.ai/mcp/wallet-inspector

Outputs are informational — on-chain reads, deterministic calculators and heuristic scans — not financial, legal or security advice. TokenOS is non-custodial and never holds keys or funds; anything you launch, deploy or sign happens from your own wallet.
capabilities: Read Solana wallet balances and holdings
Check token supply, authorities and holders

Who are the top holders of JUPyiwrYJFskUPiHa7hkeR8VUtAeFoSYbKedZNsDvCN?

positive.prompt: What does this Solana wallet hold? 9rMGbDobAM3sSzLVASEg344B392QC13pCkYLVocFnZMd
positive.expected_behavior: Returns SOL balance, token holdings with USD values where available, recent activity and an explorer link; renders the holdings widget.
Returns supply, price, market cap, mint/freeze authority status, top-holder concentration and a heuristic risk label, clearly marked as not financial advice.

positive.prompt: Who are the top holders of JUPyiwrYJFskUPiHa7hkeR8VUtAeFoSYbKedZNsDvCN?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the largest accounts with their share of supply and the top-10 concentration percentage.
Returns status (success), fee, programs invoked (ComputeBudget, spl-associated-token-account, spl-token), the SOL and USDC balance changes and an explorer link.
Tool returns a validation error explaining a base58 Solana address is required; the assistant asks for a valid address.

negative.description: Other chain — Solana-only tool; the assistant explains the limitation instead of calling it.
Price prediction — No tool call; the assistant does not make price predictions.
negative.prompt: Will BONK go up this week?

negative.description: Fund movement — Read-only plugin; the assistant declines — it cannot sign or move funds.
negative.prompt: Send 1 SOL from my wallet to this address

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.
